title: V2 dashboard export loses Dashboard-datasource query references
answers: Why does a panel show Random Walk data after importing a shared/exported dashboard?
Exported dashboard loses '-- Dashboard --' datasource reference on reimport
Panel that reuses another panel's query results breaks after export/import
How to keep Dashboard datasource references intact when exporting v2 dashboards
body:
Symptom: A v2 dashboard panel configured to use the built-in '-- Dashboard --' datasource (reusing another panel's query results) shows generated Random Walk data instead of the expected data after the dashboard is exported (Share with another instance) and reimported.
Root cause: `makeExportableV2` in public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts treated the Dashboard datasource's stable UID (`SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY` from app/plugins/datasource/dashboard/constants) as an ordinary instance-specific datasource UID and ran it through the anonymization/remapping logic, stripping the reference.
Fix pattern: before running generic datasource anonymization (label attachment / UID removal) on a DataQueryKind, add an early-return guard for known stable/built-in datasource UIDs so they pass through export unchanged.
Constraints: applies specifically to the v2 export path in exporters.ts (`makeExportableV2`); ordinary datasource anonymization, other built-in datasources, v1 export/migrations, and runtime datasource resolution are unaffected and must keep their existing remapping behavior.
